name: Adsemble Vendor Portal API Extensions
brief: Custom API pages needed by the self-hosted Vendor Portal (proveedores.jfmcss.com): posted purchase receipts and vendor ledger entries.
description: The standard Business Central API v2.0 does not expose posted purchase receipts or vendor ledger entries for this tenant. This extension adds two read-only Custom API pages so the portal can show receipts against a purchase order and payment status / account statement.
